projects.title: uxoffice®: uxtester
projects.description: uxtester® is a usability-testing tool within ISAR’s uxoffice® suite. It brings test preparation, live observation, recordings and analysis into one project.

projects.title: Bull User Echo
projects.description: Bull User Echo is an experience-data platform commissioned by Bull. It organises product reviews into dashboards, categories and alerts, helping teams explore feedback and return to the comments behind a theme.

projects.title: The Red Pack
projects.description: The Red Pack is a fictional Mars suitcase designed to enhance passengers' experience during their 7-month journey to Mars. Beyond its basic storage and transportation functions, it simulates life on Mars and features a planting module to adjust moods. At the journey's end, plants can be transplanted to Mars, symbolizing environmental transformation. This project explores how humans might adapt to extended interstellar travel and new living conditions in uncharted territories.

projects.title: Urban Interactions, UABB
projects.description: Urbanism/Architecture Bi-City Biennale (UABB) is a cultural platform whose main objective is to bring together leading voices in design to discuss issues impacting architecture in modern-day society. UABB is forward-thinking and focuses on the conceptual problems of urbanism and architecture.
paragraphs: This personal project aims to redesign the overall graphic language of the Bi-City Biennale of Urbanism/Architecture Exhibition (UABB) by establishing and using an online visual information library based on the city's sound. Allowing audiences and users to experience sound through graphics, comparing the differences in sound in different cities and regions, forming a sound-based perception of the city.

projects.title: Optech Museum
projects.description: The Optech Museum is an imaginary science museum brand, dedicated to showcasing optical instruments from early centuries to future possibilities. It provides a technical and cultural-historical survey of the development of optical instruments and science. The museum houses a rich collection that traces the history of technological advancement.

projects.title: LDTX
projects.description: BeijingDance/LDTX (LDTX) is a privately run professional dance company, co-founded in 2005 by Willy TSAO and LI Hanzhong. The company engages in all aspects of creation, performance, education, and outreach programs, providing a platform where Chinese artists can freely express their latest ideologies and sentiments, thereby advancing the multifaceted development of dance. This project aims to use pure typography to simulate the dancers' gestures and movements, and based on this concept, create the visual language and logo of the dance company.

projects.title: John Cage 4′33″
projects.description: Music exists in the space between notes. John Cage challenged traditional notation with interpretive approaches. The 4′33″ booklet uses pure typography to capture the essence of his work, inspired by his performance 4′33″.
